mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_payment_history (event_type, event_source, old_status, new_status, amount, description, payment_key, user_code, created_at) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{eventSource}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{amount}, #{description}, #{paymentKey}, #{userCode}, SYSDATETIME())

INSERT INTO erp_payment (payment_key, amount, method, status, yy, mm, student_id, center_code, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{status}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{student.studentId}, #{center.centerCode}, SYSDATETIME())

INSERT INTO erp_payment_detail (payment_key, amount, class_type, item_type, user_code, created_at) VALUES (#{payment.paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{classType}, #{itemType}, #{user.userCode}, SYSDATETIME());

INSERT INTO erp_payment_callback (bill_id, api_key, appr_state, appr_date, appr_price, appr_pay_type, appr_card_type, appr_issuer, appr_num, created_at) VALUES (#{paymentBill.billId}, #{apiKey}, #{apprState}, #{apprDate}, #{apprPrice}, #{apprPayType}, #{apprCardType}, #{apprIssuer}, #{apprNum}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_bill b ON p.payment_key = b.payment_key WHERE b.bill_id = #{billId}
